name: 黑曜石魔像
subject: An OBSIDIAN GOLEM, complete powerful humanoid of glossy but pixel-shaded black-blue obsidian shards, two heavy fists and two jointed legs, a restrained muted turquoise core and violet edge facets.

name: 烈焰獵犬
subject: A FLAME HOUND, complete muscular four-legged dark brindle dog with a full short tail, charcoal fur, small connected ember mane on shoulders and rusty orange cracks around jaw; not a generic fireball.

name: 燼翼火鳥
